explainer_content.short_definition: Polished jazz-pop and adult instrumental music where melody, tone, and mood are more prominent than improvisational risk.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Kenny G, George Benson, Grover Washington Jr., Norah Jones, Sade, and peers connect jazz vocabulary to adult pop and lifestyle listening.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It explains a huge everyday-listening pathway into jazz-adjacent sound that formal jazz histories sometimes overlook.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The music smooths the edges of jazz harmony and improvisation into recognizable melody and atmosphere.
